House Rules & Policies

Please read these carefully before booking your stay with us.

  • Check-in & Check-out Standard check-in starts at 14:00 (earliest check-in from 12:00 PM upon request). Standard check-out is by 12:00 PM. Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability and charged at RM 10 per hour.
  • Tourist Tax (Foreign Guests) A tourist tax of RM 10 per room per night is applied to all foreign guests. This is paid at check-in and is not included in the room rate shown on this site.
  • Key Card Deposit A refundable deposit of RM 50 per room card is required upon check-in.
  • Complimentary Breakfast A complimentary simple breakfast is served daily from 8:30 AM to 11:00 AM.
  • Payment Methods We are a cashless property. We accept Visa, Mastercard, JCB, and UnionPay. Cash is not accepted.
  • Age Requirements & Children Minimum check-in age is 18. Children over 7 years old are welcome. No cots or extra beds are available.
  • Pets Pets are not allowed.
  • Cancellations & Changes Need to cancel or change your dates? Just message us on WhatsApp — no fees, no forms. Specific cancellation and prepayment terms vary by rate and will be confirmed when you book.
  • Facilities Free WiFi, non-smoking rooms, air conditioning, luggage storage, and daily housekeeping. Please note: there is no parking available on-site.
